data.title: Schedule Trigger
data.description: Run the workflow every morning at a set time (e.g., 8:00 AM) to start the daily summary process.

data.title: Collect Data
data.description: Retrieve the current weather for a chosen city and fetch the latest headlines.

data.title: Compose Summary
data.description: Combine the weather information and news headlines into a concise text block ready for distribution.

data.title: Scheduled Trigger
data.description: Run the workflow on a daily schedule (e.g., every morning at 7 AM) to start the weather check.

data.title: Fetch Weather Data
data.description: Call **get_multi_city_weather** to obtain the current temperature, condition, humidity, and wind for each city in the configured list.

data.title: Build Summary Report
data.description: Transform the raw weather payload into a concise, human‑readable summary for each city (e.g., "London: 12 °C, Light rain, 78 % humidity").

data.title: Deliver Notification
data.description: Write the summary to a log file using **list_directory** to verify the output location, then optionally send the report to a messaging channel or email.

data.title: List and Filter Capitalized Files
data.description: Use the list_directory tool to retrieve all files in the target folder, then filter the list to keep only those whose names start with an uppercase letter.

data.title: Select Rhyming City
data.description: From a built‑in list of city names, pick the first city whose name rhymes with the selected file name (simple string ending match). This stage is handled by internal logic without external tools.

data.title: Fetch Weather for the Chosen City
data.description: Call the get_weather_in_city tool with the rhyming city name to obtain the current weather and output the result.
